title: Story premise ENT116: The Quiet Corner Flag
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: The quiet corner has a very loud announcement. Takeaway/theme: The way a space is announced should support its purpose.
description: A festival organizer wants a place for visitors who prefer a pause, but the quiet corner is decorated with a noisily flapping banner. They replace it with a still, clearly labeled flag icon and move the paper drum parade elsewhere, leaving a calm bench that visitors can choose freely.
